'''Bab-Neo''', or "Babno," was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Language/Legends|language]] that evolved out of [[Yperio Baobab]]'s [[Bab-Prime]]. It was a precursor to modern-day [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]].
